dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median grayscale value across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, curved, linear rake mark or shallow scratch is visible on the upper right dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent curved linear mark on the right dorsal side and faint longitudinal surface abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced and sharp dorsal ridge creating a distinct central longitudinal geometric line.
